content: Admin dashboards degrade mainly via (1) full-table COUNT before every paginated listing (EasyAdmin issue 4055 documents severe slowdowns and the skip/estimate-count workaround), (2) N+1 lazy-loaded relations producing hundreds of queries per page (WordPress admin real-world cases), and (3) missing indexes on filter columns. Fixes: EXPLAIN analysis, eager loading, cached or estimated counts, real pagination. Corroborated by EasyAdmin GitHub, WooCommerce 500k-order stress test, Query Monitor guides.
